who: a CMR reader in the janusm-readers group with the 'lge' read set; two independent readers per patient
blinding: the reader sees the CMR series only: never a CT, a scar map, the other reader's read, or a clinical report

patient.label: I have not seen any CT, scar map, clinical report or other read for this patient

patient.help: non-diagnostic ends the read: every segment is 'not assessable'

patient.label: No LGE in any segment
patient.effect: sets every assessable segment to presence = no; the reader still confirms the bull's-eye

segment.repeat: AHA segments 1-17 (Cerqueira 2002 model), shown as a bull's-eye and a list

fields.definition: your estimate of the share of this segment's myocardium that is hyperenhanced, over all the short-axis slices that make up the segment (Kim 2000's 'percent of tissue'). It is a share of tissue, not the depth at the deepest point. See the example panel.

kim_bin_examples.picture: thin bright rim along the whole endocardium of the segment, about 1/6 of the wall thick
subendocardial scar to half the wall depth along the whole segment
kim_bin_examples.note: the inner half of a curved wall holds a little less than half its tissue (about 45 % for a 10 mm wall around a 25 mm cavity radius); still bin 2

kim_bin_examples.picture: transmural scar over half the segment's width, the other half normal
kim_bin_examples.note: half the tissue; depth at its deepest point is 100 %, but the bin is set by the share

kim_bin_examples.picture: scar to 3/4 depth along the whole segment
transmural scar along the whole segment, a thin spared epicardial rim at most
bright blood pool against a dark endocardium with no wall enhancement
kim_bin_examples.note: blood is not scar; if the border cannot be told from the blood, mark the segment 'not assessable'

adjudication.trigger: any segment where the two readers differ on presence, or by >= 2 Kim bins (JA32)
adjudication.who: a third CMR reader, blind to CT
adjudication.shows: the CMR series and both reads of the flagged segments only
adjudication.fields: the same segment fields for each flagged segment; the adjudicated value is the reference

derived_not_entered: reference presence and bin per segment (agreeing reads, else adjudication)
ischaemic-pattern flag per segment (the JA32 primary analysis set)
inter-reader agreement on the Kim bin over scar-on-both segments (the JA32 anchor)
never_entered: names, dates, accession numbers, free text that could identify the patient
stored: the restricted paired collection on the project's Girder, beside the pseudonym; never in the repository
